Rule: Worker assignment requires active employment and all mandatory credentials.
Crew assignments shall not overlap unless the assignment type explicitly permits overlap.
Union classification and agreement rules shall be resolved using work location and effective date.
Prevailing wage decisions shall retain the determination source, version and calculation evidence.
Certified payroll output shall reconcile approved time, classifications, rates, fringes and deductions.
No AI recommendation may directly hire, terminate, discipline or change compensation without authorized human approval.
Geolocation shall be collected only under approved tenant policy and disclosed worker consent rules.
Sensitive HR data shall be restricted by least privilege and field-level security.
Time entries shall retain original, edited and approved values with actor and timestamp.
Credential expiration shall automatically affect eligibility according to configurable grace rules.
Fatigue risk shall be advisory unless a configured safety threshold requires escalation.
Performance decisions shall distinguish objective project evidence from manager commentary.
Candidate records shall follow configurable retention and disposition requirements.
Worker digital twin snapshots shall be versioned and reproducible from source evidence.
Payroll exports shall be immutable after transmission; corrections require adjustment batches.
Leave approvals shall evaluate available balance, staffing impact and applicable policy.
Equipment qualification shall be model/asset-class specific where required by tenant policy.
Union dispatch requests shall preserve referral sequence, response and acceptance evidence.
Cross-tenant workforce records shall never be visible without explicit authorized shared-service configuration.
Every workforce state transition shall create an audit event.
